label: kizuna_battle_c_health_01
text: No way. No way! NO WAY![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_01
text: C’mon, Miriam! Just try it![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_select_01
text: Ms. Dendra!

label: kizuna_battle_c_select_02
text: What’s wrong?

label: kizuna_battle_c_02
text: Oh! Great timing, new kid![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_03
text: Nurse Miriam here won’t try the sandwich I made![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_health_02
text: Well, DUH! I don’t want to get a stomachache![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_04
text: You won’t! Probably![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_health_03
text: Uh, I still remember that “sandwich” you made\nme with meat filling and meat for bread.\r\nThat one really messed me up bad.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_05
text: I hadn’t trained in the art of sandwich making yet\nback then! I was young and thoughtless and—[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_health_04
text: “Young and thoughtless”? It was LAST MONTH![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_06
text: Sooo, as you can see, I’m not getting anywhere\ntrying to persuade her.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_07
text: Even after I went through that intensive sandwich-\nmaking training! It kinda makes me sad...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_health_05
text: She went through intensive sandwich-making\ntraining?[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_select_03
text: She worked really hard at it!

label: kizuna_battle_c_select_04
text: You should try her sandwich

label: kizuna_battle_c_health_07
text: I guess I have no choice if you’ve got one of our\ncute little students on your side.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_health_08
text: So, fine. I’ll try your sandwich. Let’s see it.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_08
text: Yesss! I knew you’d come around. Here it is...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_health_09
text: *munch munch munch*[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_health_10
text: It’s a little strongly flavored, but...I guess it’s\nnot bad?[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_09
text: Woo-hoo! My training paid off![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_10
text: I’m so glad my sandwich pleases the great\nNurse Miriam! I look up to you, you know![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_system_01
text: You feel trusted by Ms. Dendra!

label: kizuna_battle_c_11
text: Thank you for trying it! And thanks to you too,\nnew kid![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_health_11
text: Aaand she’s run off again. That was weird...[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_battle_c_health_12
text: But that’s just how Ms. Dendra is, I guess. She’s\nalways coming into the nurse’s office with some\r\ninjury or another, too.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
